# **What is this modpack designed for?**                                                            
This modpack was created specifically for Fortol server (IP: mc.fortol.su).

The Fortol modpack is made from the best optimization mods customized for maximum performance. It includes all the necessary mods for a comfortable game on the server. Among its features: voice chat, emote craft and a lot of other stuff! ((If this causes problems, do not hesitate to contact our [Discord](https://discord.gg/KmFBxFZqJY) server for support, and we will try to help! Join us if you have any reviews that you want to share. We are waiting for any opinions.)
